description: Return the team's plan, its limits, current usage, the trial end date and the per-token MCP rate limit. Call it before deploy_site or add_custom_domain to check a plan limit instead of running into PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
name: get_account

aiGenerationsPerMonth.description: Per-calendar-month AI generation cap, team-scoped. 0 means AI is not available on this plan.

bandwidthMbPerMonth.description: Outbound bandwidth cap per month, team-scoped.

customDomains.description: Maximum number of custom domains across all sites in the team.

deploysPerHour.description: Per-token deploy_site / update_site cap inside the deploy service.

mcpCallsPerHour.description: MCP tool calls allowed per hour per token; the remaining count is in the X-RateLimit-Remaining header.

sites.description: Maximum number of sites this team may have.

plan.description: Plan name. Current plans: Free (the 14-day trial), Solo, Maker, Studio, Business. Older accounts can show Freemium or Ultimate.

planExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the current plan ends (trial-tier limits apply after it), or null if no end date is set.

role.description: This token's role on the team: owner, admin, member, viewer.

trialEndsAt.description: ISO timestamp when the 14-day trial of the team owner ends or ended, or null on a paid plan or without a trial. When a trial ends without a plan, the sites go offline and the files are kept for 30 days.

aiGenerationsRemaining.description: AI generations left this calendar month. 0 when at/over the cap.

aiGenerationsUsed.description: AI generations consumed this calendar month (UTC).

limitMb.description: Outbound MB cap for the window. 0 means unlimited.

pct.description: Percent of the cap used (0..100+). 0 when unlimited.

windowDays.description: Length of the rolling usage window in days.

customDomains.description: Currently attached custom domains across the team.

deploysLastHour.description: Deploy actions recorded in the last 60 minutes for this team.

title: Read plan, limits, and current usage
